text: It's Thursday night. One number in your model changes.
Now your memo is wrong. Your deck is wrong. Your investor update is wrong.
So you paste it all into a chatbot. It tells you what to fix... and leaves the fixing to you.
Meet Agentic Office. Your documents, spreadsheets and slides, in one workspace, with an agent that does the work.
Tell it what changed. It reads your files, finds every place that number appears, and drafts each fix.
Nothing changes without you. Every edit is marked. Accept it, or reject it.
Your team works in the same files. Their agents post a plan, and every proposal waits for a human yes.
Every file, in sync. The memo, the model, the deck... and no one copied a number by hand.
Agentic Office. Your files. Your team. Your agents. One workspace. You stay in control.
